children: Denmark’s manufacturing production dropped by 5.5% month-over-month in July 2026, slipping from a downwardly revised 6.2% growth in June and marking the steepest decline since January 2025.

Output decreased in ten out of the twelve industry groups, with the largest decline in the transport sector, which sank 21.3%, after a 27.8% surge in June, followed by electronics manufacturing (-13.9% vs 25.6%) and the metal industry (-11.6% vs 11.7%).
Activity also fell in the pharmaceutical industry (-6.2% vs 6.9%), the most important sector, which accounted for 20% of total manufacturing output.
In contrast, production increased in two industrial groups, namely manufacturing of electrical equipment and machinery, rising 0.9% (vs 3.7%) and 0.8% (vs 12.7%), respectively.

On a non-seasonally adjusted annual basis, manufacturing output rose by 4.1% in July, the softest increase in seven months and slowing sharply from an upwardly revised 13.8% gain in the preceding period.

title: Danish Manufacturing Output Falls in July
